environment.validate.intent: Validate the real execution environment and runtime conditions before resource-sensitive decisions.

resources.memory.measure.intent: Measure memory and resource availability instead of relying on named hardware assumptions.

tasks.early_stopping.intent: Use Early Stopping where meaningful for long-running workloads.

recovery.checkpoint.intent: Persist the best or recoverable Checkpoint so long-running work can resume.

behavior_change.tests.intent: Validate behavior changes with meaningful tests, starting with the smallest meaningful test before broader validation.
